title: Keyword Search Volume API
description: Bulk Google keyword search volume + CPC using the keyword-data API. Free tier returns up to 25 keywords; bulk_paid supports up to 1,000 per run. One dataset row per keyword, billed only for valid rows.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: List of keywords to look up. Each keyword gets one row with searchVolume, CPC, competition, and bid estimates. Duplicates are removed. Free tier caps at 25; bulk_paid caps at 1,000.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: free_tier returns up to 25 keywords for evaluation. bulk_paid processes up to 1,000 keywords per run for production use. Use free_tier to validate credentials and output before a paid bulk run.

countryName.title: Country
countryName.description: the keyword-data API country name for search volume context. Defaults to United States. Use exact country names as the keyword-data API expects them, such as United Kingdom, Germany, or India.

languageName.title: Language
languageName.description: the keyword-data API language name matching the selected country, such as English, German, or Spanish. Defaults to English.

includeCompetition.title: Include competition score
includeCompetition.description: Return competition (0-1 float) and competitionLevel (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH) from Google Ads. Included by default.

includeLowTopOfPageBid.title: Include low top-of-page bid
includeLowTopOfPageBid.description: Return lowTopOfPageBidUsd (Google Ads low bid estimate). Included by default.

includeHighTopOfPageBid.title: Include high top-of-page bid
includeHighTopOfPageBid.description: Return highTopOfPageBidUsd (Google Ads high bid estimate). Included by default.

maxKeywordsPerBatch.title: Keywords per batch
maxKeywordsPerBatch.description: Number of keywords sent in each the keyword-data API API request. Default 700; maximum 1000.

onPartialFailure.title: On batch failure
onPartialFailure.description: return_partial saves all successful batches and marks the run PARTIAL. fail_if_any_batch_fails stops immediately on the first batch error.

dataforSeoLogin.title: DataForSEO login (optional override)
dataforSeoLogin.description: Your DataForSEO API login email. Used only when the DATAFORSEO_LOGIN actor secret is unavailable. Keep this private.

dataforSeoPassword.title: DataForSEO password (optional override)
dataforSeoPassword.description: Your DataForSEO API password. Used only when the DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD actor secret is unavailable. Keep this private.
